comparability.p9_clock: reconstructed from historical logs, approximately one-second precision
comparability.p10_clock: perf_counter through final verification; job preparation and queue sorting excluded
comparability.pixel_difference_reason: P10 normalizes RGB to 0..1; P9 omitted division by 255
comparability.limitations: single family; historical baseline, not a repeated controlled A/B; concurrent stage sums are not additive wall time
